stemMd: A shop's daily sales were 40, 55 and 65 units on three days. How many units must it sell on the fourth day for the four-day mean to be 60?
explanationMd: A four-day mean of 60 requires total sales 240. The first three days total 160, so the fourth day must contribute 80 units.

distractorRationale.a: This would not raise the initial three-day mean enough.
distractorRationale.d: This raises the four-day mean above sixty.
distractorRationale.b: This gives a total of 235, below the required 240.
